article: コミュニティ運営の参考にしたいScratchの6つの指針
scope: Compared full Japanese source and twelve translations, six principles, remix attribution, privacy/safety, moderation/reporting wording, publication metadata, and reference URL against Scratch official guidelines.
findings: Removed duplicate future date; retained publication date 2022-09-23 and recorded lastmod 2026-11-24.
Replaced the Japanese Scratch Wiki link with the current official Scratch Community Guidelines.
Clarified constructive feedback, attribution when remixing, and reporting inappropriate content.
Reframed Scratch rules as a model to adapt rather than universal rules for every community.
Updated all twelve translations and corrected the category from it-technology to philosophy.

post/コミュニティに必要なこと/index.en.md.source: post/コミュニティに必要なこと/index.md
post/コミュニティに必要なこと/index.en.md.summary: Compared the full Japanese article and twelve translations with the current official Scratch Community Guidelines. Aligned all six principles, including constructive feedback, credit when remixing, privacy, honesty, and using Report; clarified that Scratch guidance is an example to adapt, not a universal policy.

meaning.note: Compared all six principles and the community-specific caveat across locales; restored attribution when remixing and reporting inappropriate content.

terminology.note: Checked community guidelines, remix, attribution/credit, privacy, constructive feedback, impersonation/rumors, and report function against Scratch official wording.

links.note: Replaced the Japanese Scratch Wiki URL with Scratch’s official Community Guidelines page.

limitations: AI-assisted review; no human or native-speaker certification.
These are Scratch-specific guidelines, not a complete universal moderation policy; each community must adapt them to its audience, purpose, privacy needs, and reporting process.
